              text: [32m'# Notes & Tags CRUD App with Many-to-Many Filtering (Reflex)\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'## Background\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'Build a Reflex application that manages notes labelled with tags. The data model is a classic **many-to-many** relationship between `Note` and `Tag`, joined by an SQLModel **link table**. The UI must support full CRUD over notes, attach/detach of tags (including creating new tags on the fly), and a `selected_tags` filter that uses `rx.foreach` + `rx.cond` to filter the displayed notes. The State must expose a cached computed var `all_tags` that publishes the union of tag names attached to at least one note.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'A non-Reflex CLI helper `probe.py` at the project root must expose the same data layer over stdin/stdout so the verifier can drive the schema deterministically without a browser.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'## Requirements\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'* Three SQL models inside the Reflex app:\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * A `Note` model (subclass of `rx.Model`, `table=True`) with at least an `id` primary key and a `content: str` field.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * A `Tag` model (subclass of `rx.Model`, `table=True`) with at least an `id` primary key and a `name: str` field whose values are unique.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * A separate **link table** model (subclass of `rx.Model`, `table=True`) that holds the foreign keys to `note.id` and `tag.id` and joins the two via `sqlmodel.Relationship(..., link_model=...)`. The `Note.tags` and `Tag.notes` relationships must both be configured.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* A Reflex `State` whose synchronized base vars include at least:\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * `notes`: the list of notes currently displayed (after filtering).\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * `selected_tags`: the list of tag names the user is filtering by.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* A cached computed var `all_tags` on that State that returns the union of tag names currently attached to at least one note (sorted, no duplicates).\n'[39m +
                [32m'* An index route (`/`) UI that:\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * Renders the list of notes via `rx.foreach`, where each note row uses `rx.cond` to decide whether to show based on `selected_tags` (a note is shown when `selected_tags` is empty, or when at least one of its tags is in `selected_tags`).\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * Supports creating a new note with content and a list of tag names (REDACTEDcomplete from existing tags is allowed but not required; typing a new tag name MUST create the corresponding `Tag` row if it does not already exist).\n'[39m +
                [32m"  * Supports editing a note's content and replacing its full tag set.\n"[39m +
                [32m'  * Supports deleting a note. Deleting a note must remove its link rows but MUST NOT delete the referenced tag rows.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * Supports toggling tags into / out of `selected_tags`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* A CLI helper `probe.py` at the project root (`/home/user/myproject/probe.py`) that uses the **same** `rx.Model` classes and the same database file (SQLite at `/home/user/myproject/reflex.db`). The CLI helper is invoked as `uv run python probe.py <subcommand> [args]`. Every subcommand must print exactly one JSON object on its own line on stdout (the verifier parses the last JSON object on stdout; extra log lines are tolerated). Exit code must be 0 on success and non-zero on failure. It must support the following subcommands:\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * `counts`:\n'[39m +
                [32m'    * Returns: `{"notes": <int>, "tags": <int>, "links": <int>}` reflecting `SELECT COUNT(*)` of the note, tag, and link tables.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * `ensure-tag --name <NAME>`:\n'[39m +
                [32m'    * Creates a `Tag` row with `name == NAME` if and only if it does not already exist. Idempotent.\n'[39m +
                [32m'    * Returns: `{"id": <int>, "name": <NAME>, "created": <bool>}`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * `create --content <TXT> --tags <T1,T2,...>`:\n'[39m +
                [32m'    * Creates one `Note` row. For each comma-separated tag name in `--tags`, attaches that `Tag` to the new note, creating the `Tag` row only if no row with that exact `name` already exists.\n'[39m +
                [32m'    * `--tags` is optional. If absent or empty, the note is created without tags.\n'[39m +
                [32m'    * Returns: `{"id": <int>, "content": <TXT>, "tags": [<sorted tag names>]}`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * `list [--filter <T1,T2,...>]`:\n'[39m +
                [32m'    * When `--filter` is missing or empty, returns all notes in ascending `id` order.\n'[39m +
                [32m'    * When `--filter` has at least one tag, returns notes that have at least one tag in the filter (OR semantics), in ascending `id` order.\n'[39m +
                [32m'    * Returns: `{"notes": [{"id": <int>, "content": <str>, "tags": [<sorted tag names>]}, ...]}`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * `set-tags --id <N> --tags <T1,T2,...>`:\n'[39m +
                [32m'    * Replaces the entire tag set of the note with id `N` with the comma-separated tags. Creates missing `Tag` rows as needed. Removes link rows for tags no longer attached. Never deletes `Tag` rows.\n'[39m +
                [32m'    * Returns: `{"id": <N>, "tags": [<sorted tag names>]}`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * `update --id <N> --content <TXT>`:\n'[39m +
                [32m'    * Updates the `content` of the note with id `N`. Does not touch its tags.\n'[39m +
                [32m'    * Returns: `{"id": <N>, "content": <TXT>}`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * `delete --id <N>`:\n'[39m +
                [32m'    * Deletes the note with id `N` and all its rows in the link table. Does NOT delete any `Tag` row.\n'[39m +
                [32m'    * Returns: `{"id": <N>, "deleted": true}`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * `all-tags`:\n'[39m +
                [32m'    * Returns: `{"all_tags": [<sorted tag names that are attached to at least one note>]}`. Tag rows that exist in the `tag` table but are not currently attached to any note MUST NOT appear.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'## Implementation Hints\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'* The project path is `/home/user/myproject`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* Use the project setup flow from the research plan (`uv init`, `uv add reflex`, `uv run reflex init --template blank`, `uv run reflex db init/makemigrations/migrate`). Keep all Python deps inside the `uv`-managed virtual environment; the verifier will invoke Python through `uv run`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* The application should run on port `3000` (frontend) and `8000` (backend), and be startable using `uv run reflex run --loglevel info` from the project directory. The UI will be verified on `http://localhost:3000/`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* The database must be an SQLite database located at `/home/user/myproject/reflex.db`. After `uv run reflex db migrate`, the schema must contain:\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * A `note` table (with at least `id` and `content` columns).\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * A `tag` table (with at least `id` and `name` columns).\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * A separate link table (e.g., `notetaglink` or any name) with exactly two columns which are FOREIGN KEYs into `note.id` and `tag.id`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* The link table is its own `rx.Model` with `table=True` and two `Field(..., foreign_key=...)` columns that together form the primary key. Wire the many-to-many with `sqlmodel.Relationship(back_populates=..., link_model=<LinkTable>)`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* For the filter UI, do not pre-filter on the backend just for display; perform the filter inside `rx.foreach` using `rx.cond` against `selected_tags` so the UX matches the requirements. (You may still query a sorted list of notes from the DB.)\n'[39m +
                [32m'* For `all_tags`, use `@rx.var(cache=True)` and derive it from the same data the State already holds for notes (or read from DB) so it stays in sync after CRUD operations.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* After you have finished developing, **kill all background servers** you started (e.g. `uv run reflex run`). The verifier starts the server itself.'[39m

                  [32m'        session.commit()\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        session.refresh(note)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        \n'[39m +
                  [32m'        sorted_tag_names = sorted([t.name for t in note.tags])\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        print(json.dumps({"id": note.id, "content": note.content, "tags": sorted_tag_names}))\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'def cmd_list(args):\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    filter_tags = []\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if args.filter:\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        filter_tags = [t.strip() for t in args.filter.split(",") if t.strip()]\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        \n'[39m +
                  [32m'    with Session(engine) as session:\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        if filter_tags:\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            statement = (\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                select(Note)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                .join(NoteTagLink, Note.id == NoteTagLink.note_id)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                .join(Tag, Tag.id == NoteTagLink.tag_id)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                .where(Tag.name.in_(filter_tags))\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                .group_by(Note.id)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                .order_by(Note.id.asc())\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            )\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            notes = session.exec(statement).all()\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        else:\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            statement = select(Note).order_by(Note.id.asc())\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            notes = session.exec(statement).all()\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            \n'[39m +
                  [32m'        result = []\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        for note in notes:\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            sorted_tag_names = sorted([t.name for t in note.tags])\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            result.append({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                "id": note.id,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                "content": note.content,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                "tags": sorted_tag_names\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            })\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        print(json.dumps({"notes": result}))\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'def cmd_set_tags(args):\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    note_id = args.id\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    tag_names = []\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if args.tags is not None:\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        tag_names = [t.strip() for t in args.tags.split(",") if t.strip()]\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        \n'[39m +
                  [32m'    with Session(engine) as session:\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        note = session.get(Note, note_id)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        if not note:\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            print(f"Note with id {note_id} not found", file=sys.stderr)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            sys.exit(1)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            \n'[39m +
                  [32m'        new_tags = []\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        for name in tag_names:\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            statement = select(Tag).where(Tag.name == name)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            tag = session.exec(statement).first()\n'[39m +

                  [32m'                session.refresh(tag)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            new_tags.append(tag)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            \n'[39m +
                  [32m'        note.tags = new_tags\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        session.add(note)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        session.commit()\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        session.refresh(note)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        \n'[39m +
                  [32m'        sorted_tag_names = sorted([t.name for t in note.tags])\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        print(json.dumps({"id": note.id, "tags": sorted_tag_names}))\n'[39m +

                  [32m'    note_id = args.id\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    with Session(engine) as session:\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        note = session.get(Note, note_id)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        if not note:\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            print(f"Note with id {note_id} not found", file=sys.stderr)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            sys.exit(1)\n'[39m +
